definition.label: Live container contents
definition.description: Current native liquid quantity during physical pouring, separate from the last accepted object.container definition. Flowing contents are published together after 0.3 seconds without flow, at grip release, pause or Save, and at bounded ten-second checkpoints; one Undo restores that episode. Failed publication reverts all episode quantities and stops further pouring until physics is restarted. transferredMl/spilledMl are outgoing totals for this source in the current episode, reset after publication. No per-drop rigidbodies, pools, fluid mass, mixing or buoyancy. Amounts use logical millilitres independent of visual resizing.

definition.label: A physical pour was saved
definition.description: A native pouring episode was accepted by the shared room journal (or temporary fork). Value/source is the outgoing vessel ID. transferredMl is the total received by containers; spilledMl left the bounded container model, and does not imply a persistent puddle. receivers counts distinct receiving containers. Emitted after successful publication only; failed saves, cancellation, Undo and reload do not emit/replay it. A long continuous flow publishes at most once per ten-second checkpoint. Paused lifecycle listeners may miss the event; inspect current contents instead.
